name: AgGateway: Agricultural Data Standards for AI and Precision Technology
title: AgGateway: Agricultural Data Standards for AI and Precision Technology
answer: AgGateway is a nonprofit consortium that sets open data standards for agriculture, and its website documents a webinar series on data interoperability, AI and precision technology. The most useful item for an AI reader is a session titled 'Meaning Matters: Agrisemantics in the Age of AI', which asks what role AgGateway's semantic resources play with the advent of large language models and whether machines can infer meaning on their own.

sections.body: AgGateway is a nonprofit organisation for agricultural data standards, and the pages read describe its Inside AgGateway webinar series. The series covers work of importance to the agriculture industry, including data interoperability, AI and precision technology. The pages are event and education listings rather than technical documents, and they point to sessions, panels and a white paper rather than reproducing their contents. One session was recorded on June 22, 2026, which is the only date stated in the material read.
sections.heading: What this source is

sections.body: The webinar series is the main substance. A session titled 'Meaning Matters: Agrisemantics in the Age of AI' asks what role AgGateway's semantic resources play with the advent of large language models. AgGateway's semantic resources unambiguously describe crops, field operations and lab test methods as data moves between systems. The panel discussed whether machines can now infer meaning on their own or whether such resources matter more than ever, and how AgGateway's work affects AI tools being developed. An AgGateway white paper, 'Roadmap for Data Ethics', was presented with panelists including Fred Nugen, Chief AI Officer of Seirrowon Labs, and Steve Francis of Tech Matters. A session called 'In the Field and On the Record', recorded June 22, 2026 with Bayer Crop Science, Syngenta and Corteva, covered how precision spraying by ground equipment and drones, site-specific data and autonomous equipment are changing pesticide application. It included AgriGuide's machine-actionable digital plant protection product labels and the European Precision Application Task Force's regulatory frameworks for new technologies. Other sessions cover the ADAPT Standard for farm data interoperability released in 2024, Modus v2 for agricultural lab test data, digitized scale tickets for traceability and greenhouse gas reporting, and accurate field boundaries needed for prescription application and future machine automation.
sections.heading: What it says

sections.body: The text states that the ADAPT Standard for farm data interoperability was released in 2024, that Modus v2 covers agricultural lab test data, and that 'In the Field and On the Record' was recorded on June 22, 2026. It names Fred Nugen, Chief AI Officer of Seirrowon Labs, and Steve Francis of Tech Matters as panelists for the 'Roadmap for Data Ethics' white paper, and names Bayer Crop Science, Syngenta and Corteva in connection with the precision spraying session. It also names AgriGuide's machine-actionable digital plant protection product labels and the European Precision Application Task Force's regulatory frameworks.
sections.heading: Figures and claims worth noting

sections.body: For a reader following AI in agriculture, this source is useful because it shows where the standards work sits beneath AI applications. The semantic resources described are the means by which crops, field operations and lab test methods are described unambiguously as data moves between systems, which is the condition for models to ingest feeds from machinery and sensors. The 'Meaning Matters' session frames the live question of whether large language models can infer meaning without such resources. The precision spraying session connects site-specific data, drones and autonomous equipment to pesticide application, and the field boundary session ties accurate boundaries to prescription application and future machine automation.
sections.heading: What it means for AI in Agriculture

sections.body: The pages read are webinar and education listings, so they describe sessions rather than reproduce their findings, data or recommendations. The 'Roadmap for Data Ethics' white paper is mentioned but its contents are not given. The material is promotional in the sense that it advertises the series and AgGateway's own standards, and it does not present independent evaluation of those standards. Coverage is partial, with several sessions named but not summarised, and the only date stated is June 22, 2026 for one recording.
